NARENDRAN & MURALEE KRISHNA S., JJ. ----------------------------------------------------- Suo Motu vs State Of Kerala on 14 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157192600/ 3 SSCR No.79 of 2024 ------------------------------------------------------ Dated this the 14th day of November, 2024 ORDER Anil K. Narendran, J. This report filed by the Special Commissioner, Sabarimala, pursuant to the directions contained in the order of this Court dated 20.01.2023 in SSCR No.23 of 2022, is regarding crowd management and other aspects at Sabarimala in connection with Mandala- Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25). 2. On 12.11.2024, when this SSCR came up for consideration, the learned Senior Government Pleader has made available for the perusal of this Court, in a sealed cover, the Police Bandobast Scheme in connection with Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25). We have perused the same and returned it to the learned Senior Government Pleader, in a sealed cover. By the order dated 12.11.2024, this Court ordered that it is for the respondents herein to comply with, in letter and spirit, the general directions contained in the order of this Court dated 20.01.2023 during the Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024- 25) in order to ensure that the pilgrims have a safe and comfortable pilgrimage during the festival season. Paragraph 14 of the order of this Court dated 12.11.2024 reads thus;. "14. In Suo Motu v. State of Kerala and others [2023 (4) KHC SN 11] - order dated 20.01.2023 in SSCR 23 of 2022 and DBP No.70 of 2022 - this Court issued various directions regarding (i) Police Bandobast Scheme for Mandala- Makaravilakku festival season [Para.15.4], (ii) Facilities by the Forest Department in the traditional trekking path [Para.16.5], (iii) Fixation price of food items in the eateries [Para.19.1], (iv) Annadhanam at Sabarimala, Pamba and Nilakkal [Para.20.2], (v) Crowd Management at Pamba and Sannidhanam [Para.22.5], (vi) Crowd and vehicle management at Nilakkal [Para.23.1], (vii) KSRTC buses for Sabarimala Pilgrims and Nilakkal-Pamba Chain Service [Para.25.6], (viii) Entry of Vehicles from Nilakkal and parking of vehicles at Pamba [Para.28.4]. By the order dated 20.01.2023, SSCR 23 of 2022 and DBP No.70 of 2022 were disposed of by directing that the directions contained therein are complied with, in letter and spirit, by all concerned, during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival seasons. 4.3. A multifaceted Edathavalams Bandobast Scheme incorporating all Sabarimala Edathavalams in Pathanamthitta, Kottayam, Alappuzha and Idukki districts is being implemented to provide a systematic security and assistance framework. District Traffic Regulation Scheme is in place at Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki and Kollam districts to streamline vehicle flow and aid pilgrims during the pilgrimage season. A continuous Drone Surveillance System has also been included for the entire pilgrimage season. 4.4. Having considered the submissions made at the Bar, we deem it appropriate to direct the 2nd respondent State Police Chief and the 14th respondent Chief Police Co-ordinator, Sabarimala, through the Special Officers, the Joint Special Officers, the Assistant Special Officers and the Controlling Officers, to ensure proper crowd management in Sabarimala during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25) to facilitate safe, secure, smooth and hassle-free darshan for all the pilgrims. Annadhanam at Sabarimala Sannidhanam, Pamba and Nilakkal:- The learned Standing Counsel for the Travancore Devaswom Board would submit that the Board will provide Annadhanam to pilgrims throughout the day at Sabarimala Sannidhanam, Pamba and Nilakkal. 5.1. The learned Standing Counsel for Travancore Devaswom Board would submit that the Board has constructed an Annadanam Hall at Sannidhanam with more than 1,40,000sq.ft. area, with a seating facility for 2,000 pilgrims at a time. The Board has made all arrangements for providing Annadanam to pilgrims throughout the day. Breakfast, lunch and supper will be given to the pilgrims throughout the day. Annadanam will be provided day and night continuously, with a short intermittent break of 30 minutes for cleaning and arranging the hall and the tables. A sufficient number of workers and staff are being arranged for the preparation and distribution of food. A Special Officer has been appointed in Sannidhanam for the conduct of Annadanam efficiently and without giving room for any complaint. Upma and Kadala, Chukkukappi and Chukkuvellam will be given for breakfast in the morning from 6.00 a.m. onwards. Meals with Ponni rice, Sambar, Aviyal, Thoran and Pickle/Vegetable Pulav, Salad and Pickle will be given for lunch from 12.00 noon onwards. Kuthari Kanji, Cherupayar curry and Pickle/Upma and Kadala will be given for supper in the evening from 6.00 p.m. onwards till the last person leaves Sannidhanam. 7.3. By the judgment dated 22.12.2022 - C.N. Madhusoodanan and another v. State of Kerala and others [2022:Ker:75522] this Court dismissed W.P.(C)No.40899 of 2022 holding that the restrictions regarding movement of Sabarimala pilgrims through the traditional trekking path, by fixing timings as per the order dated 25.11.2022 of the District Collector, Idukki, has been made in order to ensure the safety of pilgrims, which warrants no interference.
texts.facts: 6. KSRTC buses for Sabarimala Pilgrims and Nilakkal- Pamba Chain Service:- By the orders of this Court in SSCR No.23 of 2022, the 7th respondent Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) was directed to provide sufficient number of buses for Nilakkal-Pamba chain service, Suo Motu vs State Of Kerala on 14 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157192600/ 6 during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1199ME (2023-24). 6.4. Having considered the submissions made at the Bar, we deem it appropriate to direct the 3rd respondent District Police Chief, Pathanamthitta and the 4th respondent District Collector, Pathanamthitta to take necessary steps to ensure the availability of a sufficient number of KSRTC buses for Nilakkal-Pamba chain service, in the boarding points at Nilakkal and Pamba and to avoid congestion of pilgrims at the boarding points of KSRTC chain service at Thriveni- Pamba and Nilakkal, during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25). The Police shall ensure that senior citizens, persons with disabilities and children of tender age are permitted entry through the front door of the buses used for Nilakkal-Pamba chain service, to the extent possible, before the entry of others. The additional 15th respondent District Collector, Idukki has issued orders regulating the movement of pilgrims through the traditional trekking path. 7.1. The restrictions imposed on the movement of pilgrims through the traditional trekking path from Erumeli were under challenge in W.P.(C)No.40899 of 2022. In the said writ petition the petitioners have sought for a writ of mandamus commanding respondents 5 to 8 therein not to impose any restriction on the movement of devotees on the traditional trekking path from Erumeli, without consultation with Malayarayan tribal community and adversely affecting the traditional religious practices of that community and other devotees, or divert pilgrims to non-traditional paths to Sabarimala Temple, which is more onerous or restrictive than the restrictions on the two non-traditional paths. The movement of pilgrims through the trekking path during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25) shall be regulated by the orders of the additional 15th respondent District Collector, Idukki, fixing the timings, depending upon the number of pilgrims. 8. Fixation price of food items in the eateries:- The learned Senior Government Pleader would submit that the 4th respondent District Collector, Pathanamthitta has already issued a notification fixing the price of food items in the eateries in Pathanamthitta during Mandala-Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25). 8.1.
texts.arguments: The learned Standing Counsel would point out that the Board has already made arrangements to distribute 'Chukkuvellam' and biscuits to the pilgrims round the clock. 12. The learned Standing Counsel for the 8th respondent Kerala Water Authority would submit that the Water Authority has already made necessary arrangements at Nilakkal and Pamba to ensure uninterrupted water supply to pilgrims during Mandala- Makaravilakku festival season of 1200ME (2024-25).
